about.description: ETIS mobile is an unofficial mobile app for PSU's ETIS. It lets you use ETIS conveniently from your smartphone.
about.disclaimer: The ETIS mobile app and its developers are in no way affiliated with PSU's ETIS or its developers. Access to the app's core functionality is only available if you are a PSU student with a login and password for the system.
about.privacy: The app does not collect or share any ETIS-related information. It stores your login and password on your device for subsequent sign-in to ETIS.
